orders.text:
WPMS No. 578 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
 Mr. Kailash, Advocate holding brief 
of Mr. Nagesh Aggarwal, Avocate for the 
petitioners. 
 Learned counsel for the petitioner is 
permitted to take fresh steps upon 
respondents within one week on correct 
address. 
 Thereafter, notice be issued to 
respondents fixing 30.05.2019. 
 
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 27.04.2019
Mamta

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
WPMS No.578 of 19 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Nagesh Aggarwal, Advocate for the 
petitioners. 
 Office report indicates that notices 
were issued to the respondents on 
10.05.2019. 
 Mr. Priyanshu Gairola, Advocate has 
put in his appearance for respondent no.1. 
He seeks and is granted four weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit, as also his 
Vakalatnama. 
 As regards service upon respondent 
no.2, it is mentioned that undelivered 
envelopes have returned back with the 
remark that the addresses not found, 
whereas undelivered envelopes of notice qua 
respondent no.3 have returned back with 
the remark that she has refused to accept 
notice. 
 In such circumstances, service upon 
respondent no. 3 is held sufficient. 
 Issue fresh notice to respondent no.2, 
fixing 10.7.2019. 
 Steps be taken within a week. 
 
 
 
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 30.05.2019
Rajni
